# Pilot Scenario Analysis: Customization Feature Requirements

## Executive Summary

Analysis of 5 pilot tickets (DORA-8215, DORA-8087, DORA-7915, DORA-7760, DORA-7761) reveals **three distinct pilot scenario patterns** that require customization feature support:

1. **Location-based pilot rollouts** (waves across IKCs with location-specific variants)
2. **Ingredient/equipment configuration pilots** (Infinite Kitchen ingredient eligibility)
3. **Customization rule changes** (freemium, multi-select limits, premium topping segmentation)

**Key finding**: Pilots require **conditional customization linking to menu item variants and location-scoped configurations**.

---

## Detailed Ticket Analysis

### DORA-8215: M&A Project Mesquite

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Status** | Backlog |
| **Type** | M&A Integration Pilot |
| **Timeline** | Deal close: 7/7/26; Launch: 8-10 weeks post-close |

#### Pilot Scope
- **What**: Integrating acquired M&A target menu into Wonder ecosystem
- **Location**: Park Slope IKC (single location pilot)
- **Scope**: ~40 menu items across categories (Sandwiches, Samplers, A La Carte Meat, Kids Meal, Meats, Bowls, Sides, Sauces, Desserts)
- **Wave-based**: Single wave, post-deal-close integration

#### Menu Items Affected
**Sandwiches** (9 items):
- Brisket Sandwich, Pulled Pork, Kick'n Chicken, Sausage, Spicy Crispy Chicken, BBQ Crispy Chicken, Honey Crispy Chicken, Carolina Mustard Crispy Chicken, 2/3 Meat Samplers

**A La Carte Meats** (6 items):
- Brisket, Pulled Pork, Kick'n Chicken, Spare Ribs, Sausage Link, Half Chicken

**Other Categories** (25+ items):
- Kids Meal, Wings (3 variants), Bowls (3), Sides (12), Sauces (5), Desserts

#### Customization/Feature Requirements
- **SKU Consolidation Strategy** (not direct customization feature):
  - Items marked "Wonder SKU" → standardize on existing Wonder recipes
  - Items marked "MQ SKU" → integrate MQ (M&A target) recipes
  - Items marked "Compare SKUs + new MQ Co-mans" → create new co-manufactured options
  - Items marked "Likely Cut" or "Decision needed" → require further diligence

- **What This Requires in Customization System**:
  - Ability to **flag menu items as pilot/variant versions** with location-specific recipe mappings
  - Support for **conditional ingredient sourcing** (Wonder SKU vs MQ SKU vs Co-man)
  - **Multi-variant menu items** where the same logical menu item may use different ingredient IDs at different locations

#### Implementation Requirements
- Configure ~40 menu items with dual SKU options (Wonder + MQ variants)
- Create ingredient master data for MQ co-man items
- Set up location-based recipe routing for Park Slope IKC
- Populate linebuilds for each menu item variant

---

### DORA-8087: Configuring Infinite Kitchen for Midtown Eats

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Status** | Backlog |
| **Type** | Equipment Integration Pilot |
| **Timeline** | Config deadline: 7/20/26; Launch: Early August 2026 |

#### Pilot Scope
- **What**: Integrate Infinite Kitchen equipment for ingredient dispensing
- **Location**: Midtown East IKC
- **Scope**: 5 menu brands with BYO customizations
- **Wave-based**: Single location pilot, early August launch

#### Menu Items Affected
**Royal Greens**:
- BYO Salad

**Yasas**:
- BYO Bowl
- BYO Sandwich

**Pop Salad**:
- BYO Salad

**El Diez**:
- BYO Bowl
- Side of Corn Salsa
- Side of Pico de Gallo

**Limesalt**:
- BYO Bowl (includes 3 variants: Standard, Jasmine Rice Pilot, Cook & Chill Rice Pilot)
- BYO Tacos
- BYO Burrito
- BYO Quesadilla
- BYO Salad
- Side of Corn Salsa
- Side of Pico de Gallo

**Hanu Poke**:
- BYO Poke Bowl
- BYO Spicy Poke Bowl
- Side of Poke Rice

#### Customization/Feature Requirements
- **Ingredient Eligibility Marking**: Flag which ingredients in customizations are:
  - Dispensed from Infinite Kitchen (automated ingredient dispensing)
  - Added by hand at finishing station (manual addition)
  
- **Multi-Variant Support**: Handle ingredient variant configurations across:
  - Standard recipes
  - Jasmine Rice Pilot variants (8011570)
  - Cook & Chill Rice Pilot variants (8011834)

- **BYO Customization Structure**: Complex ingredient dependency mapping for:
  - Build-your-own bowls
  - Build-your-own salads
  - Build-your-own tacos/burritos/quesadillas
  - Side options with ingredient eligibility

#### Implementation Requirements
- Configure 5 brands × multiple menu items = ~20 menu item variants
- Create ingredient master data with "Infinite Kitchen eligible" flags
- Map customization ingredient lists to equipment dispensing points
- Set up linebuilds that differentiate Infinite Kitchen vs. manual prep ingredients
- Implement ingredient eligibility rules at Midtown East IKC level

---

### DORA-7915: El Diez/Pop Salad Freemium & Multiselect Update

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Status** | Done |
| **Type** | Customization Rule Change Pilot |
| **Timeline** | 6/17/26 (v10); 7/1/26 (C&C Pilot version) |

#### Pilot Scope
- **What**: Update free topping limits and create premium topping segments
- **Locations**: Network-wide (El Diez and Pop Salad brands)
- **Scope**: 4 menu items across 2-3 versions each
- **Wave-based**: Staggered rollout (v10 on 6/17, C&C version on 7/1)

#### Menu Items Affected

**El Diez**:
- BYO Rice Bowl, El Diez Mexican Bowls (8011372) - v10 - Scheduled 6/17
- BYO Rice Bowl, El Diez Mexican Bowls (Cook & Chill Rice Pilot) (8011830) - v2 - Scheduled 7/1

**Pop Salad**:
- BYO, Pop Salad (8011363) - v7 Draft
- BYO, Pop Salad (C&C Pilot) (8011816) - v2 Draft

#### Customization/Feature Requirements - DETAILED

**For El Diez BYO Rice Bowl**:
- **NEW Section**: Optional Addition → Choose Your Premium Toppings
  - Type: Multi-Select
  - Max: 2 options
  - Free Choices: 0 → **1** (changed from 0)
  - Items: Guacamole (4000550, 45g), Queso Blanco Sauce (4000279, 65.25g)

- **MODIFIED Section**: Optional Addition → Choose Your Toppings
  - Type: Multi-Select
  - Max: 10 → **8** (reduced from 10)
  - Removed items: Guacamole, Queso Blanco (moved to Premium section)
  - Freemium: No (not offered as free)

**For Pop Salad BYO**:
- **NEW Section**: Optional Addition → Choose Your Premium Toppings
  - Type: Multi-Select
  - Max: 3 options
  - Free Choices: 0 → **1** (changed from 0)
  - Items: Avocado (4000637, 0.5 EA), Bacon Bits (4000416, 16g), Hard Cooked Egg (4000368, 1 EA)

- **MODIFIED Section**: Optional Addition → Choose Your Toppings
  - Type: Multi-Select
  - Max: 4 options
  - Removed items: Avocado, Bacon Bits, Hard Cooked Egg (moved to Premium section)
  - Freemium: No

**Customization Feature Requirements**:
1. **Customization Segmentation**: Split single "Toppings" section into two:
   - Premium Toppings (limited free choices)
   - Standard Toppings (no free choices)
2. **Free Choice Counter**: Track and enforce free choice limits per customization section
3. **Multi-Select Constraints**: Support max selection limits per multi-select group
4. **Version Management**: Different customization rules for different menu item versions (standard v. C&C Pilot)
5. **Ingredient Pricing Variant Support**: Different section behavior based on topping type/cost

#### Implementation Requirements
- Update customization definitions for 4 menu items (2 versions each)
- Create new ingredient groupings (Premium vs Standard toppings)
- Configure free choice limits and multi-select max values
- Test freemium logic enforcement across versions

---

### DORA-7760: Raw Dough Expansion - Wave 1 (Champion IKCs)

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Status** | Backlog |
| **Type** | Equipment/Ingredient Pilot with Multi-Wave Rollout |
| **Timeline** | Wave 1 (champion IKCs) + Wave 2 (TBD) + NSOs opening 7/22+ |

#### Pilot Scope
- **What**: Expand raw dough preparation from frozen portions to fresh co-manufactured dough
- **Locations (Wave 1)**: **23 Champion IKCs** across two regions:
  - **Mo (Missouri RVP)**: Ardmore, Bench/Springfield, Bowie, Brick, Framingham, Friendship Heights, Gaithersburg, Hanover/Cranston RI, Medford, Media, Northeast Philly, Rosslyn, Sterling, Teterboro/Hackensack, Wayne, York/Mechanicsburg
  - **Deniz (Northeast RVP)**: Flatlands, Holbrook, Hudson, LES, Milford, Midtown East, Park Slope, Plainview, Scarsdale, Washington Heights, Westport

- **Wave Structure**:
  - Wave 1: 23 Champion IKCs (ready now, 12" Alanza only)
  - Wave 2: TBD locations (planned, 12" Alanza)
  - NSO Expansion: All new stores opening 7/22+ get both 12" Alanza & 16" Di Fara raw dough

#### Menu Items Affected (12" Alanza Pizzas - Wave 1)

**Alanza Pizzas (12" - Pilot versions)**:
- Pizza Classica (8010993)
- Pizza Lasagna (8010992)
- Pizza Pepperoni (8011017)
- Pizza Pesto (8010995)
- Pizza Piccante (8010994)
- Pizza Quattro Formaggi (8010997)
- Pizza Tartufo & Funghi (8010998)
- Pizza Vodka (8010996)

**Di Fara Pizzas (16" - Wave 2+ only)**:
- Regular Round Pizza (BYO) (8010990)
- Regular Round Pizza (8010987)
- Pepperoni Round Pizza (8010986)
- Pepperoni, Sausage, Meatball Pizza (8011018)

#### Customization/Feature Requirements

**NOT Direct Customization Changes** (but requires customization system awareness):
- Menu items need **location-based ingredient variants** (dough sourcing)
- Wave 1 IKCs: Use new co-man raw dough (Fresh Pizza Dough 12'' Co-Man, 5182997)
- Wave 2/NSO: Same, plus 16" dough variant (Fresh Pizza Dough 16'' Co-Man, 5182998)

**Ingredient Master Data Changes**:
- **Remove** (old frozen pilot dough):
  - 12" Dough Ball Portion (Pilot) [FZN] WSKU (4100967)
  - 12" Dough Ball Portion (Pilot) [FZN] (8807209)
  - 12" Raw Pizza Dough Ball [Portioned] (8011031)
  - Raw Pizza Dough (8011029)
  - And corresponding 16" variants

- **Add** (new co-man dough):
  - 12" Dough Ball (4000808) → Fresh Pizza Dough 12'' (Co-Man) (5182997) [New 5*, 41*, 88*]
  - 16" Dough Ball (4000809) → Fresh Pizza Dough 16'' (Co-Man) (5182998) [New 5*, 41*, 88*]

**Location-Based Customization Awareness**:
- Customization system may need to **flag location eligibility** for menu items
- Linebuilds differ by location wave (only 12" for Wave 1 champion IKCs)

#### Implementation Requirements
- Update BOMs for 12 Alanza pizza menu items with new dough ingredient IDs
- Create location-based routing (which dough variant per location)
- Configure linebuilds for each location's equipment setup (Conveyor vs Turbo Only, Pre-Portion vs Scoop)
- Update SOP documentation for dough handling, slacking, stretching
- Small wares procurement: Pizza screens, dough pans, ingredient bins

---

### DORA-7761: Raw Dough Expansion - Wave 2

| Field | Details |
|-------|---------|
| **Status** | Backlog |
| **Type** | Equipment/Ingredient Pilot - Phase 2 |
| **Timeline** | Planned for Wave 2 (dates TBD) |

#### Pilot Scope
- **What**: Expand raw dough to additional locations (Wave 2) + 16" Di Fara pizzas
- **Locations (Wave 2)**: TBD (placeholder; will follow champion IKCs)
- **Scope**: Same 12" Alanza as Wave 1, PLUS 16" Di Fara pizzas (new)
- **Wave-based**: Two-phase rollout with different menu item scope per wave

#### Menu Items Affected

**Additional 12" Alanza** (same as Wave 1):
- 8 Alanza pizza variants

**16" Di Fara Pizzas** (NEW in Wave 2):
- Pepperoni Round Pizza, Di Fara 3.0 (Pilot) (8010986)
- Pepperoni, Sausage, Meatball Pizza, Di Fara 3.0 (Pilot) (8011018)
- Regular Round Pizza, Di Fara 3.0 (Pilot) (8010987)
- Regular Round Pizza (BYO), Di Fara 3.0 (Pilot) (8010990)

#### Customization/Feature Requirements
- **Same as DORA-7760** but extended to 16" dough variants
- Menu item BOMs need **variant-aware ingredient substitution**:
  - 16" Dough Ball (4000809) → Fresh Pizza Dough 16'' (Co-Man) (5182998)

#### Implementation Requirements
- Same as Wave 1, extended to include 16" dough items
- Update BOMs for 4 Di Fara pizza items
- Dough ingredient configuration for Wave 2 locations (TBD)

---

## Cross-Ticket Pattern Analysis

### Pattern 1: Multi-Wave Location-Based Rollouts

**Applies to**: DORA-7760, DORA-7761 (Raw Dough)

**Characteristics**:
- Same menu items deployed to different location cohorts on different timelines
- Different ingredient/equipment configurations per wave
- Wave 1: 23 champion IKCs with 12" Alanza only
- Wave 2: TBD locations with 12" Alanza + 16" Di Fara
- NSO (new store openings) 7/22+: Both dough types from day 1

**Customization System Requirement**:
- **Location-scoped menu item variants** with wave-based ingredient substitution
- Ability to define "this menu item uses ingredient X at Wave 1 locations, ingredient Y at Wave 2 locations"
- Linebuilds that vary by location equipment (Conveyor vs Turbo Only, Pre-Portion vs Scoop)

---

### Pattern 2: Equipment Integration Pilots

**Applies to**: DORA-8087 (Infinite Kitchen)

**Characteristics**:
- New equipment integrated into restaurant operations
- Customization ingredients need to be marked for equipment eligibility
- Different prep workflows: Infinite Kitchen dispensing vs. manual hand-finishing
- Multiple BYO menu items with complex ingredient structures

**Customization System Requirement**:
- **Ingredient eligibility metadata** (Infinite Kitchen dispensed vs. manual)
- Support for **complex customization structures** (multi-brand BYO items with side options)
- Customization ingredient mapping to **equipment/workflow steps**
- Multi-variant ingredient support (standard, Jasmine Rice Pilot, C&C Pilot)

---

### Pattern 3: Customization Rule Changes

**Applies to**: DORA-7915 (El Diez/Pop Salad Freemium)

**Characteristics**:
- Existing menu items need customization logic updates
- Changes include: free choice limits, multi-select max values, section segmentation
- Multiple versions of same menu item with different customization rules
- Ingredient repositioning across customization sections

**Customization System Requirement**:
- **Customization section versioning** (track changes across menu item versions)
- **Multi-section customization structure** (split into premium + standard)
- **Free choice counter** (track and enforce limits)
- **Multi-select max constraints** (max 2, max 3, max 4, etc.)
- **Version-aware customization rules** (different rules for different menu versions)

---

### Pattern 4: M&A Integration with SKU Consolidation

**Applies to**: DORA-8215 (Project Mesquite)

**Characteristics**:
- Large menu integration (40+ items) from acquired brand
- Complex ingredient sourcing decisions (Wonder SKU, MQ SKU, new Co-man)
- Single location pilot (Park Slope IKC)
- Dual-recipe support for items where consolidation strategy is "Compare SKUs"

**Customization System Requirement**:
- **Menu item variant management** (support same logical item with multiple ingredient configurations)
- **Recipe/ingredient conditional selection** (which ingredient ID per sourcing strategy)
- **Pilot status flagging** on menu items
- Ability to mark items as "requires further diligence" (soft launch, gradual rollout)

---

## Customization Feature Requirements Summary

### Core Requirements (Must Support)

1. **Menu Item Versioning & Variants**
   - Support multiple versions of same menu item
   - Track pilot vs. standard variants
   - Location-scoped variants (different ingredients at different locations)

2. **Location-Based Customization Configuration**
   - Define different customization rules per location
   - Support multi-wave rollouts with different item scope per wave
   - Linebuilds that vary by location equipment

3. **Customization Section Management**
   - Create/modify customization sections
   - Support section segmentation (e.g., Premium Toppings vs. Standard Toppings)
   - Track free choices per section
   - Support multi-select constraints (max values per section)

4. **Ingredient Eligibility & Metadata**
   - Mark ingredients for equipment integration (Infinite Kitchen eligible)
   - Support ingredient variant tracking (standard, pilot variants)
   - Map ingredients to preparation workflows

5. **Free Choice/Freemium Logic**
   - Track free choice counts per customization section
   - Enforce max free selections
   - Differentiate free vs. paid ingredient selections

6. **Multi-Variant Support**
   - Menu items with multiple recipe variants (Jasmine Rice Pilot, C&C Pilot, standard)
   - Ingredient sourcing variants (Wonder SKU, MQ SKU, Co-man)
   - Version-aware customization rules

### Secondary Requirements (Nice to Have)

7. **Customization Change Tracking**
   - Version history of customization changes
   - Changelog of section/ingredient modifications
   - Rollback capability for failed pilots

8. **Ingredient Sourcing Metadata**
   - Flag sourcing strategy (Wonder, MQ, Co-man, etc.)
   - Track ingredient transitions (old → new ingredient IDs)
   - Support conditional sourcing based on location/wave

---

## Pilot Scenario Classification

### Scenario A: Single-Location Ingredient Integration
**Tickets**: DORA-8087, DORA-8215

**Definition**: New equipment or new brand integration at a single IKC location, requiring ingredient eligibility metadata and complex customization structures.

**Customization Needs**:
- Ingredient eligibility flags
- Multi-variant ingredient support
- Complex BYO customization handling
- Location-scoped configuration

**Example**: Infinite Kitchen at Midtown East requires marking which ingredients are Infinite Kitchen-eligible vs. manual-add

---

### Scenario B: Multi-Wave Ingredient Substitution Rollout
**Tickets**: DORA-7760, DORA-7761

**Definition**: Same menu items rolled out to multiple location cohorts over time, with different ingredient IDs (sourcing) per wave.

**Customization Needs**:
- Location-based menu item variants
- Wave-aware ingredient substitution
